decisions.reason: Changing the BOOT and EN pin capacitances does not change any GPIO assignment or compatibility rule.
The capacitance decision does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module model or its breakout requirement.
The BOOT and EN capacitors are unrelated to the I2C pull-ups, cable capacitance, and series-resistor configuration.
The decision does not change the panel input assignments or connector-based mounting behavior.
The BOOT and EN pin capacitances do not alter the standalone USB supply, regulator, load, or source-selection behavior.
The selected 1uF values concern ESP32 BOOT and EN pins, not the AXP2101 VMID or VSYS power-path capacitors.
The source changes ESP32 EN and BOOT pin capacitances, not the MT3608 enable pin, its pull-down, or GPIO5 control.
The capacitance change does not alter LED power cutoff behavior, its control GPIO, or the standby-current target.
Although the BOOT/reset circuit supports programming, the source decision does not change the USB-C programming interface requirement.
The BOOT and EN capacitances do not change the INA219 monitor or the rail being measured.
The BOM must continue matching the design specification, but the source does not change that requirement's current policy or tracked BOM-specific attributes.
The ESP32 BOOT and EN capacitor values do not change the sensor board's role of providing sensor connectors.
